_comment: Sentinel MCP configuration reference for Mission 1 (MMS Midway 2026).
HOW CLAUDE ACTUALLY CONNECTS
The hosted Sentinel MCP server is a remote HTTP server behind Entra OAuth,
and Claude does NOT read it from this file. Add it in the web UI:
https://claude.ai/customize/connectors  ->  +  ->  Add a custom connector
The form asks for a connector name, the MCP Server URL, an Application
(client) ID, and an OAuth Client Secret. Requires a Claude Pro, Max, Team,
or Enterprise plan. Run Register-SentinelMcpApp.ps1 first to get the ID and
secret - the app registration is a confidential client with a Web redirect
URI, so it does have a secret and you will need to paste it.
WHICH COLLECTION
Only the data-exploration collection is reachable from the Claude and
ChatGPT connectors today. The triage collection is Visual Studio Code only,
so Mission 2 runs either in VS Code or through the offline agent in
03-triage-agent-hitl. Do not promise triage-via-Claude from the stage.
AUTH IS DELEGATED
On first use the client opens the Entra consent screen, you sign in as the
demo analyst, and the token is scoped to that user. Every tool call is then
evaluated against that user's RBAC - Security Reader is enough for the demo.
The connector is a prerelease feature. Re-check the Learn article the week
of the conference:
https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/datalake/sentinel-mcp-chatgpt-claude-connector
The mcpServers block below is for clients that DO read a config file
(Claude Code, and the offline replay server used on stage).

sentinel-data-exploration._use: Mission 1 - natural-language investigation over the data lake. This is the collection the Claude connector supports.

sentinel-triage._use: Defender incidents, alerts, evidence, entities, advanced hunting.
sentinel-triage._caveat: VS Code only at time of writing. Listed here for reference; it is not usable from the claude.ai connector.

sentinel-local-replay._use: Offline fallback used for the live walkthrough. Serves a stand-in tool surface from sample data so the demo runs with no tenant and no network.
sentinel-local-replay._caveat: Tool names are illustrative, not identical to the hosted server's.
